exceptions.detail: Historical World Series frequencies, nonoccurring scenarios and tie/best-of-nine qualifications in exercise 11 were retained without reassembling the score database. The mathematical encoding and rank in exercise 10 were checked.

The full Gaussian-binomial arithmetic for the millionth canonical basis in 12(d) was not independently summed. Its binary columns and canonical pivot conditions were checked, together with the symbolic count, recurrence, algorithm invariant and seven-basis n=3,t=2 trace.
